judged_text: The header if/else is closed with `<%- end if %>`, leaving a dangling Ruby `if` modifier that only parses because the ERB compiler splices the next emitted chunk (the blank-line buffer append) into the modifier's condition slot — a typo for `<%- end -%>` whose successful parse is an accident of compiler chunk layout. The header's conditional link renders only because a truthy output-buffer append happens to serve as the accidental condition, with the blank line emitted before the link instead of after; any edit near this line or an ERB engine that terminates scriptlet chunks with a statement separator instead of a following expression turns every /embed/best render into a template SyntaxError (a 500 inside every embed iframe), and no reader can reason about the current structure.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, the conditional block is closed with `<%- end if %>` (no condition after `if`). That is not intentional Ruby and only compiles if the ERB handler happens to concatenate the next generated expression (e.g., an `_erbout << "\n"` buffer append from following whitespace) as the modifier condition. This makes the template fragile and potentially a SyntaxError depending on ERB/Erubi codegen or nearby edits; it should be `<%- end -%>`.
